messages:
Keisha: Quick heads-up: edge sample throws "Unexpected token 'export'" when deployed to Cloudflare. local esbuild bundle looks fine.
Liam: which import shape? default vs named?
Keisha: `import { createClient } from '@redwood/sdk'`. package.json in sample is "type": "module".
Aziza: runtime picks wrong build often when package lacks explicit exports. do we publish `exports` with import/require keys?
Keisha: not yet. we only ship `dist/esm` and `dist/cjs` and a single `dist/index.d.ts`.
Liam: try aliasing to `@redwood/sdk/dist/esm` in esbuild or set `conditions: ['worker','import']` to force ESM.
Keisha: alias fixed runtime. editor still shows types as `any` for overloads though.
Aziza: TS likely resolving a d.ts that includes a fallback `any` overload. two fixes: emit per-format d.ts shims (`dist/esm/index.d.ts`) that re-export root types, and remove raw `any` public fallbacks (use `unknown` or reorder overloads).
CI-Bot: filed issue SDK-1138 for export map + d.ts shims.
Keisha: I'll open a tiny repro and PR. thanks, will ping when ready. :pray:
